note: Unity prefab space, m. Model frame is level (cabin floor Y 1.07); parked on flat ground the root is pitched nose-up (Euler X = -parkedPitchDeg) and its height over the ground is parkedRootHeight (struts unloaded).

parkedHeights.note: m above flat ground in the parked pose; door sills as [front end, aft end]

ladder.note: SM_StepLadder at Socket_Ladder_Fuel_L/R (flat ground, same yaw as the plane, its +Z = the plane nose): outboard of the main wheel, platform centre ahead of the leading edge; player feet on the platform, eye 1.65 m above them (assumption, set your own). Distances from the eye at the platform centre.

propeller.note: PropBlade_1..3 are children of Propeller, pivot on the hub centre; local Y (Unity) = blade span = pitch axis. Modelled at fine pitch (blade angle 28 deg at r = 0.76 m); feather: localRotation = rest * Euler(0, -62, 0) (blade angle 90 deg at r = 0.76 m), see the contract, section 3.
